hints.text: 'Extremely' tells us to take the first and last letter of a word — that word's extreme letters. 'Suffering' signals an anagram is coming — a word will undergo suffering and become damaged, its letters rearranged.
'Feeble' and 'shiver' are our fodder — and this is all letterplay. No need to find any substitutes — just use these letters (or some of them) as the indicators direct!

This is an &lit clue (notice the !? on the end), so the whole clue is both wordplay and definition. This means our answer will be a way of describing a person who's extremely feeble and suffering a shiver.
